text:
maria: starting v2.9.1 canary to 8% across eu-west and us-west. watching p95, error_rate, and kvcache miss.
devbot: deploybot: canary rollout started for v2.9.1 -> 8% traffic. autorevert=false. metrics: p95_latency, error_rate, kvcache_miss_rate.
jon: seeing p95 +25% in us-west within first 3m, kvcache.miss_rate ~0.29. logs show kernel forward up ~100ms.
tara: any customer impact alerts? ops-bot: no SLO alerts fired yet, customer errors steady.
maria: quick options: rollback to v2.9.0 now, or try a short mitigation (cap seq_len to 1024 for canary) for 12m and reassess.
lucas: we used seq_len cap in staging and it reduced tail latency. makes sense to try before rollback.
jon: agree but prep rollback playbook. if p95 or errors cross thresholds we revert. thresholds: p95 >20% for 10m or error_rate +0.5% absolute.
tara: i'll draft internal and external blurb in case we revert. internal: "temp revert to v2.9.0 due to p95 regression in canary; investigating kvcache eviction and batching interaction." external: "We've paused a performance rollout and reverted to the prior version while we investigate latency for long-context requests."
devbot: deploybot: applying routing rule: seq_len_max=1024 to v2.9.1 traffic in us-west slice. will re-evaluate at +12m.
ops-bot: metric pulse: us-west p95 down to +7% after 4m, miss_rate falling. no error spike.
jon: good sign. keep canary running with cap for 12m. maria, please confirm you want to continue or rollback at 12m.
maria: continue with cap for 12m, rollback criteria as above. tara, share rollback commands in thread now so ready.
tara: pasted rollback checklist: 1) run `redwoodctl release rollback --version v2.9.0 --scope canary,dedicated` 2) pin pools: `redwoodctl pool pin --pool=dedicated-us-west --version=v2.9.0` 3) update release notes and notify #customer-comms.
lucas: also include db migration no-ops note if relevant.
devbot: deploybot: 12m canary check: condition met to continue with restricted rollout (seq_len cap). no rollback executed.
maria: filing follow-up ticket for research and kernel team to dig into kvcache eviction tuning and batch sizing. will schedule 30m post-rollout sync.
jon: thumbs up. will keep monitoring and escalate if errors appear.
